scripts.deps: npm run deps:shared && npm run deps:server && npm run deps:client
scripts.deps:shared: cd shared && depcruise -c ../.dependency-cruiser.js src --ts-config tsconfig.json -T err-html -f ../depcruise-shared-error.html
scripts.deps:server: cd server && depcruise -c ../.dependency-cruiser.js src --ts-config tsconfig.json -T err-html -f ../depcruise-server-error.html
scripts.deps:client: cd client && depcruise -c ../.dependency-cruiser.js src --ts-config tsconfig.json -T err-html -f ../depcruise-client-error.html
scripts.deps:html: npm run deps:html:shared && npm run deps:html:server && npm run deps:html:client
scripts.deps:html:shared: cd shared && depcruise -c ../.dependency-cruiser.js src --ts-config tsconfig.json -T err-html -f ../depcruise-shared.html
scripts.deps:html:server: cd server && depcruise -c ../.dependency-cruiser.js src --ts-config tsconfig.json -T err-html -f ../depcruise-server.html
scripts.deps:html:client: cd client && depcruise -c ../.dependency-cruiser.js src --ts-config tsconfig.json -T err-html -f ../depcruise-client.html
scripts.lint:deps: npm run lint:deps:shared && npm run lint:deps:server && npm run lint:deps:client
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
